title: Dropping Rust LinkLayer does not revoke retained authenticated evidence
description: AuthenticatedFrame liveness includes a receiving-link AtomicBool, but LinkLayer has no Drop implementation that sets it. Dropping/reprovisioning a receiver leaves retained AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext values current through frame.is_current(), so compress/decompress remain usable indefinitely without an owning LinkLayer. Revoke the receiver generation on Drop and test drop/recreate/address reuse plus all retained context/session operations.
notes: Robustness review independently confirmed no LinkLayer Drop sets the receiver retirement flag; retained contexts survive exact receiver destruction.
